summary: Verified shipping settings save + test-connection body-vs-stored key fix. Created 12 pytest cases covering: PUT persists shippo_api_key + GET returns masked value, masked-value PUT does not overwrite stored key, POST /test-connection/shippo with body key returns 200 (the primary fix - no more 400 'not configured' for unsaved keys), no-body+no-stored returns 400, masked body falls back to stored key. Also regression-tested easypost/shipstation/stamps providers. All 12 tests PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: shipping.py test-connection resolve() logic is clean; masked-key detection via '••••' prefix is consistent with GET mask format
PUT /settings strip-masked-key guards correctly avoid overwriting stored credentials when frontend re-submits the form with masked display value
shipping.py is 1310 lines - consider splitting provider clients into per-file modules for maintainability (not blocking)
test_credentials: N/A - shipping endpoints do not require auth
seed_data_creation: None. Autouse fixture resets shipping_settings to empty state before/after each test, so no junk keys are left in the DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_shipping_settings.py can be re-run standalone via `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/test_shipping_settings.py`. The autouse _reset_settings fixture wipes shipping credentials before/after every test. All 4 providers (shippo/easypost/shipstation/stamps) support body-key resolution.
rca of the issue: Original bug: test-connection endpoint read only stored settings. Fix confirmed working: test_provider_connection() now accepts Body(default=None) and uses resolve(field) helper which prefers body value unless it starts with '••••' mask or is empty. Verified via test_shippo_body_key_returns_200_without_saving passing.
